rows.title: 搜索作用阶段
rows.original_quote: During any search for the exact requested object (or for the desklamp once the target is in hand)
rows.effective_A_quote: During any search for the exact requested object (or for the desklamp once the target is in hand)
rows.effective_B_quote: During any search for the exact requested object (or, once the target is in hand, for the desklamp)
rows.origin: Parent灯任务/一般检索；Original合并检索范围
rows.condition: 精确目标尚未获得；或已持物但需找灯
rows.evidence: Goal；Parent灯Procedure；当前P1:2/8/9，Grouping G1
rows.support_boundary: 灯搜寻阶段下一句仍说exact item absent，范围衔接不够清楚；不能解释为已经有物也应无目的搜索；既有模糊，非B独有。
rows.judgment: 保留有据；阶段条件存在继承性模糊

rows.title: 覆盖方向
rows.original_quote: treat the search as coverage of distinct candidate receptacles rather than a loop over a few
rows.effective_A_quote: treat the search as coverage of distinct candidate receptacles rather than a loop over a few
rows.effective_B_quote: do not restrict the search to one container type or to a small set of locations
rows.origin: Parent系统搜索；Original位置覆盖；B强调类别
rows.transformation: 扩大覆盖维度/替换重点
rows.condition: 持续搜索未找到
rows.strength: 方向性要求，B有否定式约束
rows.support_boundary: 反重复和位置覆盖有据；跨类别是合理探索，不证明每个任务都必须访问多类别。找到即结束应优先。
rows.judgment: 方向有据；具体调度是探索

rows.title: 局部缺失触发
rows.original_quote: When the current observation shows the requested item is absent
rows.effective_A_quote: When the current observation shows the requested item is absent
rows.effective_B_quote: When the current observation shows the exact requested item is absent
rows.origin: Original继承Parent visibly lacks
rows.condition: 当前观察中未见精确目标
rows.evidence: Parent先开闭容器；当前P6:18/50到达时drawer仍closed
rows.support_boundary: 未看到不等于已检查或全局不存在；结合S08先开容器。B移动句不能盖过开容器前提。
rows.judgment: 可保留，需局部且已可检查的解释

rows.title: 移动可用性
rows.effective_B_quote: choose the next destination from the admissible 'go to' list
rows.origin: Actor基础协议已有，B在u1显式化
rows.transformation: 新增到Update文本，继承环境约束
rows.condition: 选择移动时
rows.evidence: 当前P1:4移动不在before候选→no-op；M6 S1_R03/Q6:4/10/15同类问题
rows.support_boundary: 当前证据已足够；候选提供合法移动，不提供访问进度，不保证每个合法移动有用。
rows.judgment: 有依据的明确化；不能计为历史独有增量

rows.title: 全局新颖性
rows.original_quote: move to a receptacle not yet inspected in this search
rows.effective_A_quote: move to a receptacle not yet inspected in this search
rows.effective_B_quote: sample a receptacle type not yet used in this search
rows.origin: Original/Parent全局未查位置；B换为类别
rows.transformation: 替换状态单位，未消除依赖
rows.condition: 需要判断此次搜索从未使用
rows.evidence: Execution Context；当前候选不含visited；M3/M6混合覆盖响应
rows.support_boundary: 局部近期新颖性可以探索；全局未用类别需可恢复状态。类别更少不等于两步历史足够。
rows.judgment: 已有信息依赖换了单位仍未解决

rows.title: 类别切换优先级
rows.original_quote: once that series is exhausted without the target, switch to a different receptacle type
rows.effective_A_quote: once that series is exhausted without the target, switch to a different receptacle type
rows.effective_B_quote: rather than another instance of the type just swept or a location you just saw was empty
rows.origin: Original先耗尽；B不再明示耗尽门槛
rows.transformation: 替换；放松耗尽门槛，同时偏向未用类别
rows.condition: 当前未见目标、刚扫过一类/刚看过空位置
rows.strength: 选择优先且rather than有排他性
rows.evidence: 当前P6长drawer段；M3 Q5新位置；M6 Q4扩展成功/Q2遗漏同类
rows.support_boundary: 有动机早换探索，未验证最佳切换尺度；just swept是否整类不明，不能声称B指定严格逐次轮换。
rows.judgment: 合理探索，排他强度/阶段定义尚不充分

rows.title: 同类重新进入条件
rows.effective_B_quote: go to cabinets, countertops, shelves, fridge, diningtable, or sinkbasin before re-entering the drawer series
rows.origin: Original耗尽后先换类再重入；B例示保留并移动触发点
rows.transformation: 继承局部先换类顺序，可能提前适用
rows.condition: 一段抽屉搜索未得目标
rows.strength: 局部前置顺序；不是全类别完成要求
rows.evidence: M6 Q2未访问countertop3；M9已知目标回源；当前G1 P2摘要
rows.support_boundary: 原文or是可选类别，不是全局固定排序；无“所有其他类别都采样后才返回”的明文。无条件推迟已知有价值同类位置不受证据支持。
rows.judgment: 局部探索可留；更强全类别禁返解读不成立

rows.title: 编号推进与回访限制
rows.original_quote: Sweep a numbered series of same-type containers in one direction without returning to earlier ones
rows.effective_A_quote: Sweep a numbered series of same-type containers in one direction without returning to earlier ones
rows.effective_B_quote: While sweeping the numbered instances of one container type, move in one direction and do not return to an instance you just left empty
rows.origin: Original新增单向系列；Parent仅避免立即回空
rows.transformation: 部分保留/收窄禁返对象
rows.condition: 处于一次类内扫描，刚离开位置为空
rows.evidence: 当前P3:7–11空回访；M3/M6旧避返未稳定落实；M9条件回源
rows.support_boundary: 无return to earlier ones变成just left empty，较局部；仅单向编号可借当前编号/候选执行，不能因此保证全局遍历；合理回源不应由单向扫描跨阶段禁止。
rows.judgment: 收窄有据；单向作为启发式可探索

rows.title: 先检查闭容器
rows.original_quote: open a closed cabinet/drawer/fridge on arrival and inspect its contents
rows.effective_A_quote: open a closed cabinet/drawer/fridge on arrival and inspect its contents
rows.effective_B_quote: open a closed cabinet/drawer/fridge on arrival and inspect its contents before leaving
rows.origin: Parent已明确before leaving；Original省略该短语；B恢复
rows.condition: 到达且闭合、仍需找目标
rows.evidence: 当前P6:18/50 closed；M3 Diff及开容器响应
rows.support_boundary: 不能将“未观察到目标”直接理解为离开闭容器；到达闭容器并未完成采样。额外开容器在易例可增步，不推广到与任务无关操作。
rows.judgment: 有据保留，防止采样与检查混同

rows.title: 近期循环检测
rows.original_quote: Use the most recent observations to notice when the next move would revisit a receptacle just left empty or repeat the same small set of locations
rows.effective_A_quote: Use the most recent observations to notice when the next move would revisit a receptacle just left empty or repeat the same small set of locations
rows.effective_B_quote: a location you just saw was empty
rows.origin: Parent/Original近期回空；B部分压缩
rows.transformation: 保留即时空回访，删去显式小集合循环检测
rows.condition: 近期可见且无新目标/状态变化
rows.support_boundary: 近期线索可执行；较长小集合循环本来也超两步，删除不等于降低已证有效行为；B全局类别不能替代可见局部信号。
rows.judgment: 局部保留合理；长周期能力仍有限

rows.title: 发现目标的检索出口
rows.effective_B_quote: Continue until the exact target is found
rows.origin: Parent已有；Original依赖Goal/Parent；B显式化
rows.transformation: 新增文本但继承任务阶段
rows.condition: 当前发现精确目标
rows.strength: 结束搜索而非结束任务
rows.support_boundary: 找到≠获得/处理/交付；Goal保留后续流程。灯任务找灯出口有S01模糊，不应把整任务结束混入。
rows.judgment: 继承有据；不支持任务直接终止

rows.title: 类别采样终止
rows.effective_B_quote: or every receptacle type available in the room's action list has been sampled once
rows.origin: Original无此条件；Parent是all plausible candidate receptacles inspected once
rows.transformation: 新增到Update；将Parent位置穷尽边界换成类别采样边界
rows.condition: 目标未找到但每类已采样一次
rows.object_unit: 位置检查→类别代表采样
rows.evidence: M6 P2:15/16 vs Q2遗漏countertop3；Parent首步全文；M3/M6 Diff仍为receptacles
rows.support_boundary: 部分实例不等于整类，更不等于全部合理位置。B未把它限定为一轮探索结束后继续搜；也不能推断Actor已经提前结束。调度动机不足以支持此完成标准。
rows.judgment: 新增越界承诺；文本风险已确认，行为后果未知

rows.title: 预算目标
rows.original_quote: This is coverage for finding the exact target within the step budget
rows.effective_A_quote: This is coverage for finding the exact target within the step budget
rows.effective_B_quote: This is coverage for finding the exact target within the step budget
rows.origin: Original已有，B原样保留
rows.condition: 50步总预算下搜索
rows.support_boundary: 不是guarantee；不含数值预留预算，也未规定处理交付保底。不能说B删了原有明确数值预算，因为Original不存在。
rows.judgment: 目的保留；后处理预算执行边界仍未明确

rows.title: 精确目标/不替代
rows.original_quote: it does not permit picking up, conditioning, or placing a substitute object
rows.effective_A_quote: it does not permit picking up, conditioning, or placing a substitute object
rows.effective_B_quote: it does not permit picking up, conditioning, or placing a substitute object
rows.origin: Parent/Original已有
rows.condition: 目标尚未找到或仅近似物可见
rows.object_unit: 物体类别/获取处理交付
rows.evidence: 当前P7 knife非butterknife失败；M3 Q5；M8旧Diff/响应
rows.support_boundary: 不操纵替代物不等于能够成功，也不证明目标不存在；M8不支持提前停止。
rows.judgment: 有依据保留

rows.title: 无信息无变化动作
rows.original_quote: Do not spend steps on actions that cannot change the world or reveal new information.
rows.effective_A_quote: Do not spend steps on actions that cannot change the world or reveal new information.
rows.effective_B_quote: Do not spend steps on actions that cannot change the world or reveal new information.
rows.origin: Original概括Parent反空查
rows.condition: 可知动作无状态变化且无新信息
rows.evidence: P7:11/12；M6 Q6重复不可用移动
rows.support_boundary: or允许有信息价值的非状态变化动作；不能读作所有look/inventory禁止；预先准确判断无新信息仍有认识边界。
rows.judgment: 原则有据；不是全面信息动作禁令

rows.title: no-op触发不重复
rows.effective_B_quote: If an action returns 'Nothing happens,'
rows.origin: Original新增广义反馈触发
rows.condition: 刚收到no-op
rows.evidence: 当前P1:4 off-list；M6 Q6:4/10/15 off-list
rows.support_boundary: 反馈证明当时未奏效，不证明后续所有状态都无效；原文无until state changes时限，也未明示永久。需收窄歧义而非断言已永久禁令。
rows.judgment: 状态作用域不足；当前事实可识别

rows.title: 等价动作禁重试
rows.original_quote: do not repeat that action or an equivalent one
rows.effective_A_quote: do not repeat that action or an equivalent one
rows.effective_B_quote: do not repeat that action or an equivalent one
rows.origin: Original新增，Parent限立即回空/重复空inventory
rows.condition: no-op/重复look/空inventory任一触发后
rows.strength: 排他要求，等价/时间边界不清
rows.evidence: M6 Q6同一不可用移动；当前P1:4
rows.support_boundary: 历史只支持当时同无效前提，未测试全部等价动作。无证据要求永久禁止，亦无证据说已发生禁用有效重试。
rows.judgment: 需条件限定；M6提示旧规则未兑现而非证明更强禁令

rows.title: 重复look
rows.original_quote: if a 'look' repeats the description you already have for the current receptacle
rows.effective_A_quote: if a 'look' repeats the description you already have for the current receptacle
rows.effective_B_quote: if a 'look' repeats the description you already have for the current receptacle
rows.origin: Original显式新增look触发；Parent有空位置避免重访
rows.condition: 同位置内容已知且本次look重复
rows.evidence: 当前P7:11/12相同反馈；M6空位置exam重复
rows.support_boundary: 这次look无新增信息可观察；状态变化后可能有用，不应排除；历史不提供最佳查询频率。
rows.judgment: 局部要求有据；后续适用边界需保留

rows.title: 空手inventory
rows.original_quote: if 'inventory' is issued while carrying nothing
rows.effective_A_quote: if 'inventory' is issued while carrying nothing
rows.effective_B_quote: if 'inventory' is issued while carrying nothing
rows.origin: Parent已Do not repeatedly；Original扩大为一次触发
rows.condition: 当前已知空手而发inventory
rows.evidence: P8:39/P10:25；M3/M6 Diff反重复空查
rows.support_boundary: 已知空手时反复空查无益；仅实际空手不等于Actor事先可知，首次查询可用于消除不确定性。不可机械禁止全部inventory。
rows.judgment: 重复限制有据，空手知识前提不清

rows.title: 立即状态改变
rows.original_quote: Instead immediately take a state-changing action
rows.effective_A_quote: Instead immediately take a state-changing action
rows.effective_B_quote: Instead immediately take a state-changing action
rows.origin: Original新增替代动作强度
rows.condition: 信息/no-op触发后下一步
rows.evidence: P1:4、P7:11/12浪费；M6 Q6重复无效
rows.support_boundary: 避免无信息重复不逻辑蕴含下一步只能改变状态；若必要新信息不可由观察得，应允许获取。可用动作/任务阶段需另满足。
rows.judgment: 附带强度依据不足，现有材料无实际B退化证明

rows.title: u2残留全局新位置
rows.original_quote: move to a new uninspected receptacle
rows.effective_A_quote: move to a new uninspected receptacle
rows.effective_B_quote: move to a new uninspected receptacle
rows.origin: Original继承Parent/u1进度要求
rows.condition: 决定转去搜索
rows.evidence: Execution Context；S05全局信息边界
rows.support_boundary: u1变为类别不解决u2全局未查；不是新B引入。移动可选项非每次必须移动。
rows.judgment: 继承性能力问题未修正

rows.title: 任务相关动作备选
rows.original_quote: open a closed container, take the target, perform the required clean/cool/heat, or place the target at the destination
rows.effective_A_quote: open a closed container, take the target, perform the required clean/cool/heat, or place the target at the destination
rows.effective_B_quote: open a closed container, take the target, perform the required clean/cool/heat, or place the target at the destination
rows.origin: Original整合Parent/Goal任务流程
rows.condition: 依闭合/目标可取/持有/处理完成等实际前提
rows.strength: 可选动作列举，非顺序强制
rows.support_boundary: or不是命令任意执行未满足前提动作；需Actor现有候选和Goal约束。heat有历史条件证据，当前六条无成功heat。
rows.judgment: 有效行为文本保留；不能据此保证所有前提完整

goal: Make search for the exact requested object coverage-oriented and step-efficient so the target is found, conditioned if required, and placed before the step budget is exhausted, without picking up, conditioning, or placing a substitute. Preserve the successful desklamp behavior (hold/co-locate the target and turn the lamp on at its receptacle), the direct acquire-then-place flow, and the correct clean/cool-then-place ordering already demonstrated.

checks.question: After a receptacle is inspected and the target is absent, does the Actor move to a new uninspected receptacle or switch receptacle type rather than returning to one already seen empty or re-sweeping the same series?
Does the Actor avoid repeating no-op actions ('Nothing happens,' duplicate 'look,' empty-handed 'inventory') and instead choose a state-changing action?
When the exact target is found, does the Actor still complete the required conditioning and final placement with that target, and preserve the desklamp on-while-co-located success pattern?
